verdict.rationale: Skyvern's entire product is built around delegating tasks (form-filling, logins, data extraction, invoice retrieval) to its AI-driven browser agent, which independently interprets and executes multi-step tasks without custom code (skyvern-docs-14, skyvern-docs-15, skyvern-gh-1). However, community hands-on reports show the delegated agent sometimes fails on non-trivial sites (e.g., costcotravel.com rental flow) and is costly at scale, so delegation isn't fully reliable. Missing for 10: consistent success on complex/novel workflows, and evidence of a conversational 'assistant' interface beyond task-execution runs.
